Our Story Written in the landscape
African Game Lodge is more than a destination. It is a place shaped by time, terrain and deep respect for the natural world. Set within a vast valley of the Klein Karoo, the lodge forms part of a privately owned nature reserve where wide-open spaces, mountain views and quiet mornings invite visitors to slow down.
The experience is intentionally simple and grounded: off-grid comfort, thoughtful hospitality, wildlife encounters, self-catering stays and room to breathe. Families are welcome, and the lodge is designed for guests who want nature without losing the ease of a comfortable retreat.

Our Story Our Story, Written in the Landscape
Set among vast valleys and mountains, our story is one of conservation, simplicity and timeless Karoo hospitality.
Welcome to African Game Lodge
A harmonious union of Africa's wild heart and the timeless charm of the Little Karoo awaits you at our pristine, secluded lodge â€” completely off the grid, yet full of life.
From Montagu, a 30-kilometre dirt road leads you deeper into the heart of the Karoo, to the gates of African Game Lodge. Every moment of the journey hints at the magic that awaits.
Here, on our 4,500-hectare private game reserve, time slows down. Watch the sun dip below the horizon, fire up a braai under a star-strewn sky, curl up with a book, or simply breathe in the stillness.
The land carries stories of past inhabitants and ancient geological events, while our off-grid solar approach keeps the lodge connected to the future of careful conservation.

Accommodation Accommodation
Choose from secluded luxury tents, spacious Karoo-style chalets and a bush caravan site for couples, families and groups.
Stay at African Game Lodge Experience Tailored Luxury
Guests who stay at African Game Lodge love the individual thatched Karoo-style chalets, designed to provide comfort and the opportunity to enjoy the spaciousness of the Karoo landscape.
Our luxury tents are situated about 2km from the main lodge, teeming with wildlife and birdlife. Guests can feel immersed in the wilderness, tucked out of sight and surrounded by nature.
Children are welcome at the lodge. The lodge is completely off the grid, chalets operate on 12-volt solar power, and laptops or devices may be charged in the main lodge, where Wi-Fi is available.

Luxury Tents
Where wilderness meets elegance
Experience the true soul of the Karoo under canvas, surrounded by stillness, stars and the comfort of your own private camp.
Book Your Stay Step Inside
The Luxury Tent Experience Unplug, breathe and rediscover the wild
The tents sit about 2km from the main lodge, where wildlife, birdsong and quiet views shape the rhythm of the day.
1 Bedroom Queen Bed Bathroom Self-Catering Boma-Braai Solar Lights Wildlife Views
Comfort under canvas
Inside, the tent offers a queen-size bed dressed in crisp linen, comfortable tent furniture and solar lighting for reading at night. The stoep outside has wooden furniture for taking in the scenery, and the private boma-braai creates the perfect place to cook, gather and watch the evening settle.
Attached to the tent is a bathroom with flush toilet and bath. The tent includes basic self-catering amenities, a 12-volt fridge/freezer and gas stove. Guests can feel properly immersed in nature while still having the essentials close at hand.
Children are welcome at the lodge. For families considering the tents, please contact us if you would like guidance on the best fit for your group.
Step Inside A closer look at tent life
From the warmth of the linen to your private braai fire at night, the tent experience is intimate, tactile and deeply connected to the landscape.

A secluded bush-caravan site for a group of friends and family. Facilities include shaded area, luxury bathroom with bath, open-air shower, 12-volt lights, dishwash area, small boma and separate fireplace.
